landing.headline: Virtual tours that sell the property before the first showing
landing.subhead: We shoot your listing in 360 degrees and publish it as a fast, branded listing page. Every listing ships an embed you drop straight into your own site.
landing.heroMockLabel: Illustration of the tour viewer: a panorama with navigation hotspots, a scene strip along the bottom, and a fullscreen control.

how.title: We shoot it
how.body: You send the address and access details. We capture the property in 360 degrees, room by room, and build the walkthrough. Nothing for your team to learn or upload.

how.title: You approve it
how.body: You get a private link to the finished listing page. Tell us what to change. Nothing goes public until you say so.

how.title: You embed it
how.body: The listing goes live on its own page and gives you a snippet. Paste it into your own site once; it keeps working for the life of the listing.

landing.embedIntro: Most tour vendors host your tour on their domain and put their brand around it. Yours lives on your listing page and inside your own website, sized to whatever space you give it.
embedSteps: Open the listing in your agency dashboard.
Tap the snippet to copy it. It is one line of HTML.
Paste it into your listing page where you want the tour to sit.
landing.embedSnippetNote: Every live listing generates its own snippet with its own address. This is the shape of it.
landing.embedPreviewLabel: Illustration of the embedded tour inside an agency website, with a slim bar naming the property and linking to the full listing.

features.title: A tour we capture for you
features.body: We shoot the property and build the walkthrough. You approve it. No app to learn, no gear to buy, no upload queue to babysit.

features.title: An embed for your own site
features.body: Copy one snippet into your listing page, your MLS profile, or your email. The tour fits any width and loads fast on a phone.

features.title: A listing page that converts
features.body: Full-bleed photography, the tour high on the page, the facts buyers scan for, and an inquiry form that reaches you directly.

features.title: Your brand, your domain
features.body: Your logo, your colors, your web address. Buyers see your agency, never ours.

features.title: Sold listings keep working
features.body: A sold property keeps its tour live with a sold badge. Your best work stays online as proof for the next seller.

features.title: Built for real connectivity
features.body: Mobile-first and fast on 3G. The tour waits behind a poster image until a buyer taps to explore.

included: The 360 capture session and the built walkthrough
A branded listing page on your domain
The embed snippet and its link preview card
Photography gallery and the property facts strip
An inquiry form that reaches you directly
Hosting for as long as the listing runs, sold listings included
landing.pricingBody: Pricing depends on the property: size, how many rooms need capture, and whether you want the 3D dollhouse layer. Residential and commercial are quoted differently. Ask and we will price your first one before you commit to anything.
landing.statusBody: RealEstate.WitUS is taking its first listings. Have a property to shoot? Reach out through witus.online.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.intro: What we are building for agents and brokerages on RealEstate.WitUS, in the order we are building it. Dates are targets we work toward, not promises.

items.title: Listings and 360 tours
items.body: A branded listing page per property: photography, the facts buyers scan for, and a multi-scene 360 walkthrough you move through by tapping doorways. The tour engine is ours, so there is no per-tour vendor fee riding on your listing.

items.title: Embeds you own
items.body: One snippet per listing, copyable in a tap, that drops the tour into your own website. It sizes itself to the space you give it and shares as a proper link card.

items.title: Buyer inquiries
items.body: A soft inquiry form on every listing page. No popups, no gates. Messages reach you and stay attached to the listing.

items.title: Your brand, your domain
items.body: Your logo, colors, and web address across every listing page, set up from your admin without a developer.

items.title: Floor plans synced to the tour
items.body: A floor plan beside the viewer with a live position marker, so a buyer always knows where in the property they are standing. Tap a room on the plan to jump there.

items.title: Dollhouse view for premium listings
items.body: An optional 3D dollhouse and auto-generated floor plan on the properties that warrant it, layered onto the same listing page.

items.title: Faster tour building
items.body: Wire a forty-scene commercial walkthrough by dragging connections on a map of the tour, then fine-tune each doorway. Bulk imports for large jobs.

items.title: View analytics
items.body: How many buyers opened the tour, how long they stayed, and which rooms held them. Per listing, in plain numbers.

items.title: Multi-building and campus properties
items.body: Apartment blocks, complexes, and campuses as one property with many units, where a single lobby tour serves every unit listing.

items.title: Ownership transfer
items.body: Hand a property and its tours to another agency when the listing moves, with both sides confirming and the embeds never breaking.

items.title: Self-serve capture
items.body: Shoot and publish your own tours on the same engine, once the service pipeline has proven the workflow.

roadmap.outro: Something your listings need that is not here? Tell us through witus.online.
